cards.name: Noivern
cards.description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

attacks.name: Second Bite
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sonic Bazooka
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage and your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Pokémon Catcher
cards.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Potion
cards.effect: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Poké Ball
cards.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Professor’s Letter
cards.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Potion
cards.effect: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Switch
cards.effect: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
